pinyin: hǎo hàn zuò shì hǎo hàn dāng
literal: good · fellow · do · things · good · fellow · bear
natural: a real man bears the consequences of what he does

meaning.en: A person of courage takes responsibility for his own actions.
meaning.zh: 有胆量的人敢做敢当，不推卸责任。

equivalents: to take responsibility for one's actions

examples.zh: 好汉做事好汉当，这事是我干的，跟他们无关。
examples.en: A real man takes responsibility: I did it, it's nothing to do with them.

examples.zh: 出了问题别躲，好汉做事好汉当。
examples.en: Don't hide when things go wrong; own up to it.

usage.en: Often said by someone taking the blame; sometimes with 一人做事一人当.
usage.zh: 常为承担责任者所说，也说“一人做事一人当”。

pinyin: ài měi zhī xīn, rén jiē yǒu zhī
literal: love · beauty · 's · heart, everyone · all · has · it
natural: everyone has a love of beauty

meaning.en: Everyone appreciates beauty and wants to look good.
meaning.zh: 每个人都喜欢美、希望自己好看。

examples.zh: 爱美之心，人皆有之，男生也爱护肤。
examples.en: Everyone loves beauty; men care about skincare too.

examples.zh: 爱美之心，人皆有之，她花很多时间化妆也不奇怪。
examples.en: Everyone has a love of beauty; no surprise that she spends time on make-up.

usage.en: Typically said to justify caring about appearance.
usage.zh: 常用来为注重外表辩护。

pinyin: lǎn lǘ shàng mò shǐ niào duō
literal: lazy · donkey · go to · mill · dung · urine · many
natural: a lazy donkey sent to the mill keeps needing to relieve itself

meaning.en: A lazy person finds endless excuses to avoid work.
meaning.zh: 懒人一干活就找各种借口躲避。

equivalents: a lazy man always finds an excuse
to find any excuse to skive

examples.zh: 一说干活他就肚子疼，真是懒驴上磨屎尿多。
examples.en: As soon as work starts he gets a stomach ache: a lazy donkey always has to go.

examples.zh: 懒驴上磨屎尿多，别听他的借口。
examples.en: A lazy donkey always has an excuse; ignore him.

usage.en: Crude, folksy; for a person who dodges work.
usage.zh: 较粗俗，指躲避干活的人。

pinyin: dǎ shé bù sǐ, hòu huàn wú qióng
literal: hit · snake · not · dead, later · trouble · endless
natural: if you don't kill the snake, trouble is endless

meaning.en: Do not leave an enemy half-beaten, or he will come back to harm you.
meaning.zh: 对敌人不彻底消灭，将来会有无穷后患。

equivalents: never leave a wounded enemy behind

examples.zh: 打蛇不死，后患无穷，要么不动手，要么一次解决。
examples.en: If the snake isn't dead, trouble follows; either don't strike or settle it once.

examples.zh: 打蛇不死，后患无穷，这次必须彻底处理。
examples.en: This time we must deal with it thoroughly.

usage.en: Advice to finish a conflict completely; can sound ruthless.
usage.zh: 主张斩草除根，语气有些狠。

text: 舍得一身剐，敢把皇帝拉下马
pinyin: shě de yī shēn guǎ, gǎn bǎ huáng dì lā xià mǎ
literal: willing · one · body · be sliced, dare · take · emperor · pull · down · horse
natural: if you're willing to be cut to pieces, you dare pull the emperor off his horse

meaning.en: If you are ready to risk everything, nothing is beyond you.
meaning.zh: 豁出性命，什么事都敢做。

examples.zh: 舍得一身剐，敢把皇帝拉下马，他放手一搏。
examples.en: Willing to risk everything, he gave it his all.

examples.zh: 舍得一身剐，敢把皇帝拉下马，这就是创业的精神。
examples.en: That's the entrepreneurial spirit: risk it all.

usage.en: Bold, defiant; sometimes used humorously.
usage.zh: 带有豪气，有时用于玩笑。

text: 撑死胆大的，饿死胆小的
pinyin: chēng sǐ dǎn dà de, è sǐ dǎn xiǎo de
literal: stuffed · to death · bold · ones, starved · to death · timid · ones
natural: the bold overeat to death, the timid starve

meaning.en: Risk-takers may gain or lose big, but the timid get nothing.
meaning.zh: 敢冒险的人容易发财，胆小的人一无所获。

examples.zh: 撑死胆大的，饿死胆小的，当年他敢做生意发了财。
examples.en: Fortune favours the bold; he got rich by daring to do business.

examples.zh: 撑死胆大的，饿死胆小的，但也别盲目冒险。
examples.en: Fortune favours the bold, but don't take blind risks.

usage.en: Often encourages risk-taking but with irony.
usage.zh: 鼓励冒险，常带调侃。

pinyin: duō nián xí fù áo chéng pó
literal: many · years · daughter-in-law · endure · become · mother-in-law
natural: after many years the daughter-in-law has endured her way to being a mother-in-law

meaning.en: After long years of hardship, one finally reaches a position of authority.
meaning.zh: 经过多年的苦熬，终于有了地位和话语权。

equivalents: to work one's way up through the ranks

examples.zh: 多年媳妇熬成婆，他终于当上了部门主管。
examples.en: After years of service, he finally became head of department.

examples.zh: 多年媳妇熬成婆，她终于有自己的办公室了。
examples.en: After all those years she finally has her own office.

usage.en: Sometimes implies the newly empowered may treat juniors as they were treated.
usage.zh: 有时暗示熬出头的人可能会像当年的婆婆一样对待后辈。

pinyin: dà zhàng fū néng qū néng shēn
literal: great · man · can · bend · can · stretch
natural: a great man can bend and can stand tall

meaning.en: A strong person knows when to yield and when to stand firm.
meaning.zh: 有本事的人既能忍耐退让，也能抓住机会施展抱负。

equivalents: discretion is the better part of valour

examples.zh: 大丈夫能屈能伸，暂时低头不算丢人。
examples.en: A great man can bend and stand; bowing for now is no shame.

examples.zh: 大丈夫能屈能伸，先忍一时之气，再作打算。
examples.en: Swallow your pride now and plan later.

usage.en: A consoling phrase for someone who has to swallow an insult.
usage.zh: 常用来安慰忍受委屈的人。

text: 子不嫌母丑，狗不嫌家贫
pinyin: zǐ bù xián mǔ chǒu, gǒu bù xián jiā pín
literal: son · not · dislike · mother · ugly, dog · not · dislike · home · poor
natural: a son doesn't mind his mother's looks, a dog doesn't mind its home's poverty

meaning.en: One should love one's family and homeland, however humble.
meaning.zh: 不应嫌弃自己的母亲和家乡，不论贫富美丑。

equivalents: home is where the heart is

examples.zh: 子不嫌母丑，狗不嫌家贫，他一直深爱着家乡。
examples.en: A son does not dislike his mother for being plain; he deeply loves his hometown.

examples.zh: 子不嫌母丑，狗不嫌家贫，家再破也是家。
examples.en: However shabby, home is home.

usage.en: Often said about loyalty to one's home or motherland.
usage.zh: 多用来说明对家乡、祖国的忠诚。

synonyms: 金窝银窝不如自己的草窝

text: 宁拆十座庙，不毁一桩婚
pinyin: nìng chāi shí zuò miào, bù huǐ yī zhuāng hūn
variants: 宁拆十座庙，不拆一桩婚
literal: rather · tear down · ten · temples, not · ruin · one · marriage
natural: better to pull down ten temples than break up one marriage

meaning.en: Never break up a marriage; saving one is worth more than any good deed.
meaning.zh: 劝和不劝离，破坏婚姻罪过很大。

equivalents: mend a marriage, don't break it

examples.zh: 宁拆十座庙，不毁一桩婚，我们劝他们别离。
examples.en: Better ten temples than one marriage: we urged them not to separate.

examples.zh: 宁拆十座庙，不毁一桩婚，别乱掺和别人的婚姻。
examples.en: Don't meddle in other people's marriages.

usage.en: Often the full form is 宁拆十座庙，不拆一桩婚; used to urge reconciliation.
usage.zh: 也说“宁拆十座庙，不拆一桩婚”，常用于劝和。

text: 死了张屠夫，不吃混毛猪
pinyin: sǐ le zhāng tú fū, bù chī hùn máo zhū
literal: die · Zhang · butcher, not · eat · unscraped · pig
natural: even with butcher Zhang dead, we won't have to eat pigs with the bristles on

meaning.en: No one is indispensable; if someone leaves, others will take over.
meaning.zh: 少了谁，事情都能照样办成。

equivalents: the world won't stop for one man

examples.zh: 死了张屠夫，不吃混毛猪，他走了公司照样运转。
examples.en: The firm carries on without him; no one is indispensable.

examples.zh: 死了张屠夫，不吃混毛猪，不必求他。
examples.en: There's no need to beg him; someone else can do it.

usage.en: Sometimes a defiant response to a threat to leave.
usage.zh: 常作对要挟离开者的硬气回应。

pinyin: shā rén bù guò tóu diǎn dì
literal: kill · person · no more than · head · touch · ground
natural: at worst killing someone is a head rolling to the ground

meaning.en: Punishment should not go beyond the crime; enough is enough.
meaning.zh: 惩罚不应过分，得饶人处且饶人。

equivalents: don't rub salt in the wound
let the punishment fit the crime

examples.zh: 杀人不过头点地，他已经道歉了，你就别再追究了。
examples.en: Enough is enough; he apologised, so drop it.

examples.zh: 杀人不过头点地，没必要这么羞辱人。
examples.en: No need to humiliate him so much.

usage.en: Also used to say that a harsh penalty is the worst that can happen so there is no need to be afraid.
usage.zh: 也可表示最坏不过如此。

pinyin: chuán dào jiāng xīn, bǔ lòu chí
literal: boat · reach · river · centre, mend · leak · late
natural: mending the leak when the boat is in mid-river is too late

meaning.en: Act before it is too late; remedies come too late once disaster is under way.
meaning.zh: 等到事态严重再补救就太迟了。

equivalents: a stitch in time saves nine
to lock the stable door after the horse has bolted

examples.zh: 船到江心，补漏迟，现在才检查已经来不及了。
examples.en: Mending the leak in mid-river is too late; checking now is too late.

examples.zh: 船到江心，补漏迟，平时就该做好防护。
examples.en: Do the safeguarding in advance.

usage.en: Often paired with 马行半坡，勒缰晚 as a warning.
usage.zh: 常与“马行半坡，勒缰晚”并提。

pinyin: luó bo kuài le bù xǐ ní
literal: radish · fast · not · wash · mud
natural: radishes sold quickly aren't washed of mud

meaning.en: When things sell fast, quality gets neglected.
meaning.zh: 买卖太快，质量往往被忽视。

equivalents: if it sells fast, don't bother about quality

examples.zh: 生意太好了，他们萝卜快了不洗泥，质量下降了。
examples.en: Business is so good they've stopped bothering with quality.

examples.zh: 萝卜快了不洗泥，赶工的东西质量难保证。
examples.en: Rushed goods rarely have guaranteed quality.

usage.en: Often criticises quality problems in a hot market.
usage.zh: 常批评热销时忽视质量。

pinyin: xuè zhài yào yòng xuè lái cháng
literal: blood · debt · must · use · blood · to · repay
natural: a blood debt must be repaid with blood

meaning.en: Murder must be avenged; a violent crime demands punishment in kind.
meaning.zh: 杀人要偿命，血债必须血还。

examples.zh: 血债要用血来偿，受害者家属不愿和解。
examples.en: A blood debt must be paid in blood; the victims' families will not settle.

examples.zh: 血债要用血来偿，这是复仇者的信条。
examples.en: A blood debt is repaid in blood: the avenger's creed.

usage.en: Strong, vengeful; used in historical or war contexts.
usage.zh: 语气强烈，多用于历史、战争语境。

pinyin: chǒu qī jìn dì jiā zhōng bǎo
literal: ugly · wife · near · field · home · in · treasure
natural: a plain wife and nearby fields are the treasures of a home

meaning.en: A plain but hardworking wife and fertile fields near home are real blessings.
meaning.zh: 相貌平平的妻子和近处的好地，才是家中的宝贝。

equivalents: a good wife is better than a pretty one

examples.zh: 丑妻近地家中宝，他娶了个勤快的妻子。
examples.en: A plain wife and near fields are treasures: he married a hardworking wife.

examples.zh: 丑妻近地家中宝，看人不能只看外表。
examples.en: Don't judge people by looks alone.

usage.en: Traditional farmers' wisdom; the female-appearance angle is outdated, but the point is practicality.
usage.zh: 传统农家智慧，对女性相貌的看法较过时，本意是实用重于外表。

pinyin: xū yào shì fā míng zhī mǔ
literal: need · is · invention · 's · mother
natural: necessity is the mother of invention

meaning.en: Great inventions arise from real needs.
meaning.zh: 需要促使人们发明创造。

equivalents: necessity is the mother of invention

examples.zh: 需要是发明之母，疫情期间出现了许多新发明。
examples.en: Necessity is the mother of invention; many new inventions appeared during the pandemic.

examples.zh: 需要是发明之母，孩子们为了方便造了个小装置。
examples.en: Necessity is the mother of invention: the children built a small gadget.

usage.en: A calque of the English proverb.
usage.zh: 译自英语谚语。

text: 饭后一支烟，赛过活神仙
pinyin: fàn hòu yī zhī yān, sài guò huó shén xiān
literal: meal · after · one · cigarette, surpass · living · immortal
natural: a cigarette after a meal beats being an immortal

meaning.en: A smoker's slogan claiming smoking brings supreme pleasure (now seen as an unhealthy excuse).
meaning.zh: 烟民常说饭后抽烟舒服似神仙（现在多视为不健康的说法）。

examples.zh: 饭后一支烟，赛过活神仙，这是老烟民的口头禅。
examples.en: Veteran smokers say a post-meal cigarette is heavenly.

examples.zh: 别信饭后一支烟，赛过活神仙，对身体伤害大。
examples.en: Don't believe that saying; smoking is bad for you.

usage.en: A jocular saying, now often quoted ironically given health campaigns.
usage.zh: 半开玩笑，如今常带讽刺引用。

text: 鱼生火，肉生痰，青菜豆腐保平安
pinyin: yú shēng huǒ, ròu shēng tán, qīng cài dòu fu bǎo píng ān
literal: fish · produce · heat, meat · produce · phlegm, green · vegetables · tofu · keep · safe
natural: fish brings heat, meat brings phlegm, greens and tofu keep you safe

meaning.en: A folk saying advising simple, light meals for good health.
meaning.zh: 民间养生说法，提倡饮食清淡。

equivalents: a light diet keeps you healthy

examples.zh: 鱼生火，肉生痰，青菜豆腐保平安，爷爷天天吃素。
examples.en: Grandpa eats simply every day, saying greens and tofu keep you safe.

examples.zh: 医生说鱼生火，肉生痰，青菜豆腐保平安，也要适量吃肉。
examples.en: The doctor says greens and tofu are safe, but we also need some meat.

usage.en: A traditional dietary saying, not strictly scientific.
usage.zh: 传统养生俗语，并不完全科学。

pinyin: yǒu qí shī, bì yǒu qí tú
literal: has · such · teacher, must · have · such · disciple
natural: such a teacher, such a pupil

meaning.en: Students resemble their teachers, for good or ill.
meaning.zh: 学生往往像老师。

examples.zh: 有其师，必有其徒，他和老师一样严谨。
examples.en: Like teacher, like pupil: he's as meticulous as his master.

examples.zh: 有其师，必有其徒，这个球队的作风就是教练的作风。
examples.en: The team's style is the coach's style.

usage.en: Can praise or criticise.
usage.zh: 可褒可贬。

pinyin: yǒu suǒ dé bì yǒu suǒ shī
literal: have · what · gained · must · have · what · lost
natural: where there's a gain there must be a loss

meaning.en: Every gain has a cost; you cannot have everything.
meaning.zh: 得到什么，就要失去些什么。

equivalents: you can't have your cake and eat it

examples.zh: 有所得必有所失，选了稳定就要放弃自由。
examples.en: Every gain has a cost: choosing stability means giving up freedom.

examples.zh: 有所得必有所失，他得到了事业，却失去了家庭时间。
examples.en: He gained a career but lost family time.

usage.en: Philosophical; used to console or to explain trade-offs.
usage.zh: 带哲理，用于安慰或解释取舍。

pinyin: chūn shēng xià zhǎng, qiū shōu dōng cáng
literal: spring · sprout, summer · grow, autumn · harvest, winter · store
natural: sprout in spring, grow in summer, harvest in autumn, store in winter

meaning.en: The natural rhythm of the four seasons and of farming.
meaning.zh: 四季更替和农事的自然规律。

equivalents: to everything there is a season

examples.zh: 春生夏长，秋收冬藏，农事要顺应天时。
examples.en: Farming must follow the seasons: sow, grow, reap, store.

examples.zh: 春生夏长，秋收冬藏，这是自然的规律。
examples.en: Sprout, grow, harvest, store: that's nature's rhythm.

usage.en: Describes the seasonal cycle; also for life stages.
usage.zh: 描述四季循环，也可比喻人生阶段。

pinyin: qīng míng qián hòu, zhòng guā diǎn dòu
literal: Qingming · before · after, plant · melons · sow · beans
natural: around Qingming, plant melons and sow beans

meaning.en: Farm lore: the Qingming period is the time to sow melons and beans.
meaning.zh: 农谚：清明前后是播种瓜、豆的时节。

examples.zh: 清明前后，种瓜点豆，农民们都忙着下地。
examples.en: Around Qingming it's time to sow melons and beans, and farmers are in the fields.

examples.zh: 清明前后，种瓜点豆，爷爷在菜园里忙开了。
examples.en: Grandfather is busy in the vegetable garden.

usage.en: Traditional farming proverb tied to the solar term 清明 (early April).
usage.zh: 与清明节气相关的农谚（约四月初）。

pinyin: yī cháng chūn yǔ yī cháng nuǎn
literal: one · spell · spring · rain · one · spell · warmth
natural: each spring rain brings more warmth

meaning.en: Each spring rain makes the weather warmer.
meaning.zh: 每下一场春雨，天气就暖一些。

examples.zh: 一场春雨一场暖，天气一天比一天暖和了。
examples.en: Each spring rain makes it warmer; it's getting warmer every day.

examples.zh: 一场春雨一场暖，该换薄衣服了。
examples.en: Time to change into lighter clothes.

usage.en: A weather proverb; often paired with 一场秋雨一场寒.
usage.zh: 天气谚语，常与“一场秋雨一场寒”对举。

text: 久晴必有雨，久雨必有晴
pinyin: jiǔ qíng bì yǒu yǔ, jiǔ yǔ bì yǒu qíng
literal: long · fine · must · have · rain, long · rain · must · have · fine
natural: after long sunshine comes rain, after long rain comes sun

meaning.en: Weather, and fortune, always change after extremes.
meaning.zh: 天气和命运极端之后总会转变。

equivalents: every cloud has a silver lining
what goes up must come down

examples.zh: 久晴必有雨，久雨必有晴，不要太担心。
examples.en: After long rain comes sun; don't worry too much.

examples.zh: 久晴必有雨，久雨必有晴，生意也有起伏。
examples.en: Business rises and falls too.

usage.en: A weather proverb used to encourage patience.
usage.zh: 天气谚语，也用来劝人耐心等待转机。
